# ignitify_secret (Resource)

A tenant secret, read by tasks. The value is write-only: it never reaches the plan or the state. Needs Terraform 1.11+ or OpenTofu 1.11+. Works with a user key that holds secrets.read and secrets.write.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "db_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

# The value is write-only: it never reaches the plan or the state.
# Raise value_wo_version to send a new value.
resource "ignitify_secret" "db_password" {
  name             = "DB_PASSWORD"
  value_wo         = var.db_password
  value_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `name` (String) The secret name (1 to 64 upper case letters, digits and '_', starting with a letter). A change replaces the secret. The import id.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The secret value (write-only). Terraform cannot see a change of it: change value_wo_version to send it again.

### Optional

- `value_wo_version` (Number) Any number. A change sends value_wo to the API again.

### Read-Only

- `updated_at` (String) When the value was last written (ISO 8601). A change made outside Terraform shows here.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is the secret name.
terraform import ignitify_secret.db_password DB_PASSWORD
```
